maddeler.e:
أعتزل (form VIII)
# أَعْتَزِلُ (ʔaʕtazilu) /ʔaʕ.ta.zi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# أُعْتَزَلُ (ʔuʕtazalu) /ʔuʕ.ta.za.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# أَعْتَزِلَ (ʔaʕtazila) /ʔaʕ.ta.zi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# أُعْتَزَلَ (ʔuʕtazala) /ʔuʕ.ta.za
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
